tier_reason: The R2.13 release table (1920x1080, GrayS/YUV444PS, fps) matches the record exactly (T4 342.23, V520 152.20, Hygon 7390 207.90, Sapphire Rapids 598.43, EPYC Zen4 674.37 at radius 0; 18.15/19.91/21.50/49.50/59.87 at radius 1 chroma final), but it only times the project's own CUDA, HIP and AVX2 backends; no reachable page gives a number against VapourSynth-BM3D, FFmpeg bm3d or any other incumbent, so there is no comparative evidence and the tier stays D.

corrections.hardware: R2.13 notes: NVIDIA T4 (AWS g4dn.2xlarge, Linux 6.2.0-1014-aws, driver 545.23.06, CUDA 12.3), AMD Radeon Pro V520 (AWS g4ad.2xlarge, Linux 6.2.0-1014-aws, ROCm 5.7.1), Hygon C86 7390 32C @ 2.70 GHz, Intel Sapphire Rapids 32C @ 3.4 GHz and AMD EPYC Zen4 32C @ 3.4 GHz (all three CPUs on Windows Server 2022); VapourSynth R65-RC1-6-g3dcc6a35. R2.14 adds Intel Arc A770 (252.46 fps) and Data Center GPU Max 1100 (323.51 fps) at radius 0, chroma False, final False.
corrections.caveats: Tier D: no fps or speedup against VapourSynth-BM3D, FFmpeg bm3d or any other recognizable baseline appears in the README, releases R2.8, R2.13, R2.14, R2.17, or the 25 issues (none about speed). The R2.13 table only compares the project's own backends; notably the 32-core AVX2 CPU build beats the T4 GPU build in every row. No benchmark script is published and the CPU builds' compiler and flags are unstated. The README says the filter does not do identical work to VapourSynth-BM3D: sigma strength is only similar because coefficient normalization is not implemented, large ps_num values can regress quality because duplicate block-matching candidates are not handled (not an issue in VapourSynth-BM3D), and CPU and CUDA outputs are not bitwise identical (GPU output is non-deterministic unless extractor_exp is set). Release R2.8 notes a VAggregate rewrite about 40% faster than the previous version (own history, 0-5% overall). A third-party PR (AmusementClub/vapoursynth-nssfactory #10, RTX 5080, 1080p GrayS) times bm3dcuda only as the baseline for another CUDA port (bm3dcuda 206/144/123/82 fps against nss_cuda 191/139/110/66; spatial nss_cuda 1.06-1.10x bm3dcuda), not against the CPU plugin. Doom9 threads that search snippets suggest discuss speed are blocked here. R2.17 temporarily disables the HIP release; open issues report a possible memory leak (#31) and bm3dhip failing to load with AMD Adrenalin 26.5.1+ (#33).

notes: Record is accurate: numbers, license (GPL-2.0, LICENSE file is GPL v2), 88 stars, 15 forks, not archived or a fork, last commit 2026-09-26 all match. WebFetch's summary of the releases page dated R2.17 to 2024-09-26, but R2.17's notes cite CUDA 13.4.2 and the matching commit is dated Sep 26, 2026, so the record's 2026 date stands. Kept as D (not rejected) per the keep-and-document rule; under the prompt's strict rules it would qualify as not-notable-tier-d (88 stars).
